project_type: SvelteKit static-adapter SPA (public Chhath Puja transparency portal, live at chhath.shaharpura.com)
build_system: npm + Vite 8 (rolldown). SvelteKit adapter-static. PATH must PREPEND /root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin.
test_framework: vitest (jsdom). Tests colocated under src/**/*.test.ts. Source-scan style tests read files with node:fs and assert on their text (see src/lib/seo.test.ts, src/lib/pwaManifest.test.ts).
build_command: cd Public/frontend-v6 && export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" && npm run build
verification_instructions: From Public/frontend-v6: `npm ci` (node_modules already present, can skip), `npm run check` must stay 0 errors / 0 warnings (svelte-check --fail-on-warnings), `npm test` (vitest) all green, `npm run build` succeeds and stays within the client-JS-size budget (<= 700000 bytes, enforced by scripts/first-load-bytes.mjs; GTM snippet is external from Google CDN so it does not count against the bundle).
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. Build output goes to build/ (gitignored). Budget checked by scripts/first-load-bytes.mjs against build/.
setup_instructions: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH"; cd Public/frontend-v6; node_modules already present (npm ci if needed).
environment_constraints: Scope ALL changes to Public/frontend-v6 ONLY. Do NOT touch frontend-v2..v5 or mgmt apps. Do NOT add any npm dependency (GTM is a script snippet + a dataLayer push). All window/document/dataLayer access must be browser-guarded (SSR/prerender safe). CI job public-frontend-v6 enforces the JS-size budget.
contribution_requirements: Keep npm run check at 0/0. Keep vercel.json a valid schema with NO non-schema keys (a prior 'comment' key broke the Vercel schema). CSP is a single valid string.
key_patterns: app.html is a static template (cannot read Vite env directly) with a no-flash theme
directory_structure: Public/frontend-v6/src/app.html (static HTML template); src/routes/+layout.svelte (root layout, overlays, PWA register, navigation); src/lib/** (components, stores, utils, colocated *.test.ts); vercel.json (headers incl. CSP); scripts/first-load-bytes.mjs (budget gate).
